core_obligations: Normalize a simply typed term using the authors I/gamma/K strategy with a decreasing measure.
Infer a uniform intersection typing for the resulting normal form.
Propagate this typing backwards through all strategy steps using the complete subject-expansion proofs and recover nonempty collapsed environments.
